decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX extends the firm's well-established trommel screening know-how, so the firm can interpret its market feedback and keep improving it within its core competence.

The mobile high-speed grinder draws on related comminution knowledge and gained relevance after Products B and E were dropped, but its low visibility on the website and the possibility of consolidating the line still create some risk.

The stationary electric fine shredder sits further from the mobile core and has had little visibility, but it fits the push toward stationary, resource-saving plants and builds knowledge the firm needs for that direction.

The single-shaft pre-shredders build closely on the firm's shredding expertise, have their own product page, and support the expansion into stationary plants, so the firm is well placed to keep developing them.
